source: Local archived SEC Financial Statement Data Sets, SUB primary registrant. SIC assigned as of filing date; validate cached rows against archived sub.txt and registered ZIP hashes.
identity: Use frozen ranking entity_id cik:NNNNNNNNNN only; no current ticker mapping or co-registrant inheritance.
availability: Both filed_date and accepted calendar date strictly before signal date; latest filing by filed_date then acceptance, maximum age 400 calendar days. Conflicting latest SIC labels, invalid latest SIC, unknown dates and missing identity stay unknown; no fallback to earlier valid labels.
inputs: Frozen 57 ranking/forward CSV pairs of #40/#48; retain original eligibility and oriented percentiles. Verify original result input hashes before reading returns.
statistics: Descriptive within-division quarterly Spearman IC; equal-date mean, ICIR, positive fraction, periods and pairs; fixed 2011-15/2016-20/2021-25 windows. Publish every group/date status, including no pairs or insufficient pairs and constant series; no p-values or new factor classifications.
coverage: All original eligible candidate-dates, including missing returns. Publish identity, selected dated filing, valid division, exclusion reason, per-factor finite pairs and coverage stratified by outcome availability.
preservation: Separate supplement; original scores/rankings/returns, global IC/Holm, classifications, model weights and blind studies remain frozen. SIC is not GICS and this does not reconstruct sector-neutral scores or repair original regressions/placebos.
evidence: Descriptive retrospective metadata only; no automatic confidence upgrade, OOS claim or ensemble component selection. Historical outcomes already observed in original Factor Zoo.
